title: Expenditure, payroll and month-end controls (Pinagpala Hardware and Construction Supply, February 2027)
topic: Expenditure cycle, payroll, fixed assets and close
summary: 35 documents at a hardware and construction supply store: purchases and payments, payroll, fixed assets and the month-end close. Review each packet, post the valid ones with the right journal and hold the ones that fail a control, naming the control. Harder than Set 1: partial deliveries, tolerances, delegated approvals, orders split to avoid a limit, a reformatted duplicate invoice, and clean documents that look wrong.

template.title: Payroll: approved overtime

template.title: Payroll: new hire, part of the period

key.explanation: The new hire started on February 8 with a signed personnel action, so 56 hours (seven days) is the right pay for the period. Do not hold a mid-period start.

template.title: Fixed assets: a tire replacement booked as an asset

fields.Description: Four replacement tires for the delivery truck

fields.Reason: The truck is a fixed asset

key.explanation: New tires keep the truck in working order. They do not extend its life or capacity, so they are a repair and maintenance expense, not a fixed asset.

template.title: Fixed assets: a delivery motorcycle

key.explanation: A motorcycle with a long life, approved by the General Manager, received and registered. Capitalize it: fixed assets {{net}}, input VAT {{vat}} and the payable {{gross}}.

template.title: Fixed assets: depreciation booked before the asset was in use

fields.Policy: Depreciation starts the month after the asset is placed in service

key.explanation: The motorcycle went into service on February 24. By policy depreciation starts in March, so booking a month of depreciation ({{dep}}) in February charges the wrong period.

template.title: Fixed assets: sale of an old delivery van at a gain

key.explanation: Remove the van and its accumulated depreciation, record the cash and output VAT, and take the {{gain}} difference between the {{price}} price and the {{cv}} carrying amount as a gain on disposal.

fields.Basis: Meter reading on 2027-02-28 and the January rate
